# AWL - Deploy Power BI

## Purpose

Deploy Power BI PBIP and PBIX reports.

---

## Features

- PBIP Deployment
- PBIX Deployment
- Dataset Refresh
- GitHub Step Summary

---

## Inputs

| Input | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| workspace-id | Power BI Workspace |
| deployment-type | pbip / pbix |
| artifact-path | Build Artifact |
| report-name | Report Name |
| dataset-refresh | Refresh Dataset |

---

## Used By

- awl-deploy-powerbi.yml

---

## Version

v1.0
